description: This file implements the cache tree data structure and related functions for managing directory hierarchies within a version control system, likely Git. It includes functions for creating, freeing, updating, invalidating, reading, writing, and verifying cache trees, as well as managing subtrees and sparse directories.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree * cache_tree(void)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new cache_tree structure with default values.

methods.name: void cache_tree_free(struct cache_tree ** it_p)
methods.description: Recursively frees a cache_tree and its subtrees, ensuring proper memory deallocation.

methods.name: int cache_tree_subtree_pos(struct cache_tree * it,const char * path,int pathlen)
methods.description: Performs a binary search to find the position of a subtree within a cache_tree based on a given path.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree_sub * find_subtree(struct cache_tree * it,const char * path,int pathlen,int create)
methods.description: Finds or creates a subtree within a cache_tree for a specified path segment.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree_sub * cache_tree_sub(struct cache_tree * it,const char * path)
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a subtree for a given path.

methods.name: int do_invalidate_path(struct cache_tree * it,const char * path)
methods.description: Recursively invalidates cache tree entries along a given path.

methods.name: void cache_tree_invalidate_path(struct index_state * istate,const char * path)
methods.description: Invalidates the cache tree entries for a specified path in the index state.

methods.name: int verify_cache(struct index_state * istate,int flags)
methods.description: Verifies that the cache tree is consistent and merged, optionally silent.

methods.name: void discard_unused_subtrees(struct cache_tree * it)
methods.description: Removes subtrees that are not marked as used from a cache_tree.

methods.name: int cache_tree_fully_valid(struct cache_tree * it)
methods.description: Checks if the cache tree is fully valid and all objects are present.

methods.name: int must_check_existence(const struct cache_entry * ce)
methods.description: Determines whether the existence of a cache entry must be checked based on promisor remote configuration.

methods.name: int update_one(struct cache_tree * it,struct cache_entry ** cache,int entries,const char * base,int baselen,int * skip_count,int flags)
methods.description: Recursively updates a cache_tree based on current cache entries, handling subtrees and object validity.

methods.name: int cache_tree_update(struct index_state * istate,int flags)
methods.description: Updates the cache tree of the index and commits changes if necessary.

methods.name: void write_one(struct strbuf * buffer,struct cache_tree * it,const char * path,int pathlen)
methods.description: Serializes a cache_tree node and its subtrees into a buffer.

methods.name: void cache_tree_write(struct strbuf * sb,struct cache_tree * root)
methods.description: Serializes the entire cache tree into a buffer.

methods.name: int parse_int(const char ** ptr,unsigned long * len_p,int * out)
methods.description: Parses an integer from a buffer, updating the pointer and length.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree * read_one(const char ** buffer,unsigned long * size_p)
methods.description: Deserializes a cache_tree structure from a buffer.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree * cache_tree_read(const char * buffer,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Reads and constructs a cache_tree from a buffer.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree * cache_tree_find(struct cache_tree * it,const char * path)
methods.description: Finds a cache_tree node corresponding to a given path.

methods.name: int write_index_as_tree_internal(struct object_id * oid,struct index_state * index_state,int cache_tree_valid,int flags,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Generates a tree object from the index, optionally ignoring the cache tree, and outputs its oid.

methods.name: struct:tree * write_in_core_index_as_tree(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Creates a tree object in the repository from the in-memory index's cache tree.

methods.name: int write_index_as_tree(struct object_id * oid,struct index_state * index_state,const char * index_path,int flags,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Writes the index as a tree object, optionally with a prefix and flags.

methods.name: void prime_cache_tree_sparse_dir(struct cache_tree * it,struct tree * tree)
methods.description: Sets a sparse directory's cache_tree to a specific tree object.

methods.name: void prime_cache_tree_rec(struct repository * r,struct cache_tree * it,struct tree * tree,struct strbuf * tree_path)
methods.description: Recursively builds cache tree structures based on a given directory tree.

methods.name: void prime_cache_tree(struct repository * r,struct index_state * istate,struct tree * tree)
methods.description: Initializes and populates the cache tree for a repository and index.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree * find_cache_tree_from_traversal(struct cache_tree * root,struct traverse_info * info)
methods.description: Finds the cache tree node corresponding to the current traversal position.

methods.name: int cache_tree_matches_traversal(struct cache_tree * root,struct name_entry * ent,struct traverse_info * info)
methods.description: Checks if a cache tree entry matches the current traversal context.

methods.name: int verify_one_sparse(struct index_state * istate,struct strbuf * path,int pos)
methods.description: Verifies that a directory marked as sparse in the index matches its cache tree.

methods.name: int verify_one(struct repository * r,struct index_state * istate,struct cache_tree * it,struct strbuf * path)
methods.description: Recursively verifies the integrity and consistency of the cache tree and index.

methods.name: int cache_tree_verify(struct repository * r,struct index_state * istate)
methods.description: Performs verification of the cache tree associated with an index.

methods.name: int subtree_name_cmp(const char * one,int onelen,const char * two,int twolen)
methods.description: unavailable
